correctness.rationale: Exact vertex and simplex definitions yield a complete 2-skeleton, no 5-faces and 73n connected-four-set tetrahedra. The explicitly packaged 36 cyclic orbit templates each delete n nonlocal tetrahedra by genuinely free triangular faces, leaving a union Y of n adjacent cube complexes. Exact rank-35 signed 56x38 boundary algebra and a determinant -1 primitive minor give each cube the homotopy type wedge of three 3-spheres. Contractible overlap gluings yield H3(Y)=Z^(3n), H2(Y)=0; the remaining complex adds only <=2-dimensional relative cells to Y. This preserves H3, makes H2 free, and the simply connected Euler calculation gives rank binom(4n-1,3)-70n. The standard low-dimensional Whitehead argument gives the integral sphere wedge. Verification script actually replayed the cube matrix and all collapses n=6..13; the proof of all n>=13 uses bounded column locality. Computation alone is not treated as an infinite proof.

originality.rationale: published-finding corpus queries covering the exact ordinary four-cut torus, connected-four-set dual, alternate descriptions and stronger graph-family scope were checked, alongside accessible earlier claim statements. Relevant primary complete result texts and both foundational grid/cut-complex preprints were compared. The square-cylinder theorem has an open, not periodic, boundary and computes only one group; the periodic papers are on three-cuts, and the general four-cut theorem excludes girth-four graphs. None implies the new full integral homotopy decomposition. Novelty is best-knowledge, with explicit risk of unindexed equivalence.

value.rationale: The family is the natural first periodic width-four case beyond rectangular square cylinders and previously resolved toroidal three-cuts. The result completely determines its integral Alexander-dual homotopy type for every n>=6 and all original-cut integral homology, including two adjacent ranks and nonshellability. The topological change from an open chain of local cubes to a closed cycle is substantive; the explicit cyclic collapse and integral freeness proof are not simply a routine evaluation of a published formula. It supplies a motivated infinite-family classification without asserting a wider arbitrary graph theorem.
